title: The Latest Crier for Sep 22, 2026
items:
Intramural Flag Football Sign-Ups EXTENDED

Intramural Flag Football sign-ups have been extended! If you missed the original deadline, you still have time to get a team together and sign up. The new deadline will be September 27. 
Plus, Pickleball and Sand Volleyball sign-ups are now open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! 

Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

Behavior Science, Humanities, and Non-Profit Majors Career & Internship Fair

Tuesday, October 13 | 11am-1pm | Graham Conference Center | 20 Employers so far Need a resume review? Upload to Handshake and one of the CR & EL Team will review.Register in advance & Check In day of for a chance to win a Career Readiness Bundle.Go to:central.joinhandshake.com to see the employers who are coming and to register.

Cooking with Spanish Club!

Join Spanish Club for a fun, hands on cooking event featuring traditional food and recipes from Nicaragua, hosted by a special guest! 
We’ll learn how to make a few traditional dishes, try something new, and enjoy some good food together. No Spanish experience is needed, but we’ll also learn some Spanish words and phrases along the way! 

When: October 4, 6–8 PM 

Where: Garden Cottage 

Spots are limited, so make sure to sign up! 

Sign Up Here 

Come cook with us! ¡Nos vemos! 🍴🇳🇮

Common Ground Friendship Bracelet Making

Common Ground will be hosting a LNC on September 25th from 7:30-9:30 pm in the BMW rooms. There will be materials for making bracelets, earings, and keychains as well as a caramel apple bar and other snacks.

Show your school spirit by decorating a window for homecoming!

Sign up on your own or with up to 9 of your friends! We'll supply the red, white, and black paint, plus the brushes. All groups will be entered to win a $50 gift card, but the top prize is $100! Sign up here by 9/23 at 5 pm to enter. Windows will be judged on 10/2. See your area coordinator for more info on the judging criteria!

Fellowship of Christian Athletes (FCA)

YOU’RE INVITED! 

Interested in building your Christian community here on campus? Join us for week three of FCA this Tuesday in the BMW rooms at 8pm ! 

We’ll continue learning about the Proven summer camp theme, with two of our student leaders guiding us in discussion. Don’t forget to bring your friends and your Bible! 

Next Week: Fields of Faith 🏈 

On Tuesday, 9/29 , we’ll be meeting on the football field for Fields of Faith. There will be fun games and a great message from JR Sumrall, the FCA football team chaplain at Iowa State University. 

We hope to see you there! 

FCA Leadership Team
